title: Newton Support Functions and Metric Completion of Singular Conformal Metrics at Corners
summary: We study singular conformal metrics \(g=Fg_0\) near codimension-two corners, where \(F\) is a finite positive sum of monomial singularities. The competing orders are encoded by the homogeneous Newton support function \(\mathcal H(p,q)=\max_j(pa_j+qb_j)\). We prove the sharp projective accessibility criterion \(\mathcal H(p,q)<2\min\{p,q\}\), and deduce that the corner lies at finite metric distance exactly when \(\max_j(a_j+b_j)<2\).
